rows.title: Review: Suspenseful and wrenching, 'Tori and Lokita' is the Dardenne brothers' best in years
rows.dek_lead: There’s a scene near the end of “Tori and Lokita,” Jean-Pierre and Luc Dardenne’s strongest work in nearly a decade, that illustrates the difference — the chasm, really — between empathy and identification.
